text:
Alice Chen: Heads up — ACME's active seats and API calls dropped ~40% this week after they hit the eval/llm change. Onboarding flow shows last success step 3 weeks ago. Need a 48h save plan.
Marcus Li: Saw the spike in 2023-10-18 02:14 UTC, likely after model rollout. I ran a quick query: `SELECT day, api_calls FROM usage WHERE account='acme' ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 14;` calls down from 4k -> 2.3k/day.
Priya Patel: Thanks for flagging. Do we know cause: model outputs changed (quality) or infra perf?
Marcus Li: Early check: latency and error rates stable. Samples show more hallucinations in pricing-related prompts. Possible prompt mismatch after model swap.
Katy Nguyen: Support has 3 open threads about unexpected summaries and missing fields. They escalated at 11:12 this morning. Ticket IDs: CS-8421, CS-8423, CS-8427.
Diego Ramos: I can run a focused eval harness on their canonical prompt set and diff the responses vs previous model. Give me the prompt list and I’ll have results in ~6 hours.
Alice Chen: OK tactical plan: 1) Immediate reactive: route ACME to previous verified model variant for 48h, 2) Enable a live enablement session with their PM + CSM, 3) Run lightweight eval + surface failure modes, 4) Draft save messaging + temporary rate/budget concessions if they want.
Priya Patel: For (1) we can set routing override — @eng-runtime FYI — can someone cut a rollback route? If not possible, we'll rollback at the customer level.
Marcus Li: I'll open a routing override: `PATCH /routing/overrides` with body `{ "account": "acme", "model": "v2.1-stable" }`. If deploybot blocks, I'll escalate.
onboard-bot: [automated] churn_risk=high score=0.78 reason="activation dip + tickets"
Katy Nguyen: I'll coordinate the CSM touch and schedule a 30-min enablement call. Proposed times: tomorrow 10:00 or 15:00 PT.
Diego Ramos: Eval run queued. Will post sample diffs + 3 worst-response snippets.
Alice Chen: Messaging draft for outreach (short): "We noticed a drop in activity and some off-nominal outputs after a recent model update. We’ve temporarily switched your account to a verified variant while we investigate and can set a time to walk through fixes. Apologies for the disruption — we’ll prioritize restoring expected outputs." Thoughts?
Priya Patel: Add: "If you'd like, we can run a joint test during the call with your real prompts and adjust prompt templates live."
Marcus Li: Owners + SLAs: Marcus -> routing override (ETA 1h), Diego -> eval report (ETA 6h), Katy -> customer call (ETA 24h), Alice -> scripted save message + escalation to AM (ETA 3h).
Katy Nguyen: I'll add a short CS play doc to the thread with talking points and concession thresholds (trial credits up to $3k, up to one PRP).
Alice Chen: Agree. If we don't see re-activation within 72h after the rollback and enablement, escalate to renewals for a retention credit conversation.
Priya Patel: Noted. Also capture their feedback into the model-onboarding checklist so future rollouts include these prompts/edge cases.
Marcus Li: Routing override applied, response: 200 OK. (timestamp 1898765460).
Diego Ramos: Eval done — attaching top 3 diffs inline: 1) pricing summary omitted line-items, 2) tone changed from formal->casual when asked for invoice wording, 3) hallucinated currency conversion. Will paste examples in follow-up.
Alice Chen: Nice. Next steps: execute the 30-min call, test live prompts, confirm routing holds, and monitor usage 3x/day. If metrics rebound -> close with win; if not -> escalate.
Katy Nguyen: Calling from CS agenda: 1) confirm impact, 2) live test, 3) remediation plan, 4) concessions. Sending invite now to acme-pm@acme.com for 10:00 PT.
Alice Chen: Thanks team. Keep thread updated with outcomes. :thumbsup:
